final_architecture.name: Hybrid Architecture #2
final_architecture.design_rationale: Hybrid design keeping Course, Enrollment, Progress as stable services while offloading bursty workloads to serverless functions. Balances operational control with elasticity. Selected through 3 multi-agent evolutionary cycles, achieving a final multi-objective fitness of 83.0/100. Incorporates 9 components tailored for Online learning platform with async messaging.
